changeSummary: Follow one public catalog GET through Edge, Shield, App and Store; state who handles misses, fills and replies.
Explain fixed original hard expiry, remaining HTTP freshness, authoritative conditional validation, asynchronous outbox/purge completion and cache-copy limits in complete Chinese sentences.

exactExamples.old: 第一笔先闭环：新鲜命中只走 Client → Edge → Client。40,000/s 是入口峰值假设，不是每层都接到这个数。
exactExamples.new: 先看最短的完整往返：Edge 新鲜命中时，请求只走 Client → Edge → Client。每秒 4 万次是入口峰值，并不表示每一层都收到这么多请求。

exactExamples.old:
Edge 新鲜命中就直接返回；miss 进入 Shield，Shield miss 才到 App。App 查 L1 / Cache tier；后者只回 hit 或 miss。miss 回到 App，由 App SELECT Store、接收行，再 guarded SET。HTTP 回程仍经过 Shield、Edge。缓存没有数据库连接，这是 demand-filled look-aside。[4]

SET 失败不必丢弃刚读到的权威行：年龄与权限合格仍可返回。Store 超时却没有缺席证明，不能缓存 null 或返回 404。
exactExamples.new:
一次公开目录读取先到边缘缓存 Edge；新鲜命中就直接返回，未命中才进入父缓存 Shield。Shield 也未命中时，请求才到应用服务 App。App 再查本地缓存 L1 和图中的远程缓存 Cache tier，后者只返回命中或未命中。未命中后，App 自己查询 Store，接收记录，再向缓存发起带原子资格校验的回填（guarded fill）。HTTP 响应仍经 Shield、Edge 返回客户端。这种按需填充的旁路缓存没有数据库连接。[4]

如果回填 SET 失败，刚读到的权威记录仍可在年龄和权限都合格时返回。Store 查询超时则没有证明商品不存在，因此不能把结果缓存为 null，也不能返回 404。

exactExamples.old:
Store 新快照明确缺席才存类型化 absent，与下架状态分开；hard age 5s，CDN 404 也只用剩余期限。创建同样提交 outbox，删除负记录并撤销旧缺席 token，否则“旧查询缺席 → 创建并 DEL → 迟到 SET absent”会复活 404。超时、连接失败、permit 拒绝返回 503，不造缺席。

A9：重复 100 个 key 共 2,000/s。若把查询耗时、淘汰和全部安全余量都忽略，TTL 理想模型才是 100/5=20 次/s。实际 claim 只在 hard>now+2s 时命中：5s 硬期限仅提供不足 3s 的 L2 复用，瞬时填充/持续重复时约 100/(5−2)=33.3 次权威读/s。首波仍可同时 100 次；这不是任何一秒或端到端的上界。

App 的 canSend 还扣 1s 检查到发送余量，所以同一缺席证明只在年龄不足 2s 时能成功回 404。当前 HTTP 伪代码对年龄不合格返回 503，不自动重读；若要持续成功须另定刷新/验证策略并计入 Store 预算。共享 HTTP 命中与到源条件验证也改变频率，不能把 33.3/s 当端到端容量结论。每次换新 id 则零复用。

先查格式、租户权限、入口配额。Bloom 过滤器的无假阴性只覆盖已同步集合；新建尚未加入旧过滤器会误拒，需创建登记或新增 overlay。同步未知就预算内查权威；假阳性只增加读取，不能授权对象。图中省略整段 HTTP 层，内部路径未跳过已画出的调用者。
exactExamples.new:
只有 Store 的新快照确认对象不存在，App 才保存类型明确的 absent，并把它与商品下架状态分开。负记录的硬期限为 5 秒，CDN 的 404 响应也只能使用剩余期限。创建商品时，同样要提交 outbox、删除负记录并撤销旧查询的填充令牌；否则，“旧查询确认不存在 → 创建并 DEL → 旧查询迟到 SET absent”就可能让 404 再次出现。超时、连接失败或回源额度不足都返回 503，不能编造不存在的结论。

A9 中，100 个 key 被重复访问，合计每秒 2,000 次。只有忽略查询耗时、缓存淘汰和全部安全余量，TTL 理想模型才得到 100/5=20 次读取/秒。实际 claim 要求 hard>now+2s 才算命中，因此 5 秒硬期限只提供不足 3 秒的 L2 复用时间。在瞬时填充、持续重复访问的假设下，权威读取量约为 100/(5−2)=33.3 次/秒。首波仍可能同时发起 100 次读取，所以它既不是任意一秒的上限，也不是端到端上限。

App 的 canSend 还要预留从检查到发送的 1 秒，因此同一份不存在证明，只有在年龄不足 2 秒时才能成功返回 404。当前 HTTP 伪代码对年龄不合格的数据返回 503，不会自动重读；若要持续成功响应，就要另外设计刷新或验证策略，并计入 Store 预算。共享 HTTP 命中和到达源站的条件验证也会改变读取频率，不能把 33.3 次/秒当成端到端容量结论。每次更换新 id 时，仍然没有复用收益。

处理请求时，先检查格式、租户权限和入口配额。Bloom 过滤器的“无假阴性”只针对已经同步的成员集合；新建记录还没进入旧过滤器时，直接拒绝会误伤，因此需要在创建时登记，或加一层保存近期新增成员的 overlay。无法确认同步状态时，就在预算内查询权威数据；假阳性只会增加读取，不能授予对象访问权限。本组图省略了整段 HTTP 层，图中已经画出的内部调用者仍要逐跳经过。

steps: A public GET misses Edge and Shield, reaches App, and misses L1/Cache tier. Cache claim returns a fresh token; origin admission consumes the shared read/concurrency budget.

After receiving the token, App starts a NEW primary snapshot at observedAt=100000ms and receives positive version 2 at 100200ms. hardExpires remains 120000ms. Within the 1000ms claim lease, fill checks token/epoch, floor<=2 and safe hard age in one cache transaction.
At response construction now=100200ms, canSend checks 100200+2000+1000<120000. n=min(10,floor((120000-100200-2000-1000)/1000))=10. Final send must complete within the declared one-second interval.
Return via App→Shield→Edge→Client, with HTTP Date/Age preserved and accumulated. A rejected fill would not itself discard a permission- and age-qualified primary row.

counterexamples.name: revoked old e7 cannot overwrite e8
steps: Old reader receives e7, opens a fresh primary query and obtains v1. Another writer commits v2 and a durable invalidation outbox.
Cache invalidation atomically raises floor to 2, revokes e7 and evicts. New e8 must query primary afresh and may fill v2.

Late SET(v1,e7) fails the token check; it cannot overwrite v2. Checking the token outside the write transaction, or merely expiring a lock, would not provide this guarantee. Already sent v1 remains bounded by the original hard age.

counterexamples.name: negative L2 HIT is not enough for successful404
steps: Absence evidence has observedAt=100000ms and hard=105000ms. At now=102500ms, L2 claim passes 105000>102500+2000 and can return HIT.
App canSend fails because 102500+2000+1000 is not below 105000. Current HTTP policy returns 503 no-store and does not automatically reload.
Thus 100/(5-2)≈33.3 reads/s describes the L2-only ideal workload, not continuous successful404 throughput or any peak limit.

counterexamples.name: Store timeout is unknown
steps: An admitted Store read times out. No new snapshot has confirmed absence.
Return503/no-store, do not store absent or return404. A logical timeout does not release a still-executing physical SQL concurrency slot.

frames.title: Start with the checkout boundary
frames.desc: Client sends POST /orders to Order App.

frames.title: One atomic transaction on Primary
frames.desc: Client calls Order App; Order App runs SQL on Primary. Primary returns COMMIT to Order App after the required WAL durability barrier.

frames.title: Idempotency and indexes share the commit
frames.desc: Primary commits order, lines, conditional stock, the unique caller/key result, and secondary indexes. COMMIT returns Primary to Order App to Client.

frames.title: Replica reads buy capacity with lag
frames.desc: Primary fans WAL out to two asynchronous peers represented by Replica pool. A stale-allowed list travels Order App to Replica pool; rows return Replica pool to Order App. Client responses always pass through Order App.

frames.title: Confirmation rejects lagging reads
frames.desc: Complete row-store path. The red alternative Order App to Replica pool rejects routing confirmation to a lagging replica. Confirmation uses Primary; lists may use Replica pool.

frames.title: One-key routing chooses a coordinator
frames.desc: Client sends one-key PUT or GET to KV Coordinator. The preferred replica set for K is N1, N2, N3.

frames.title: Replication fans out from the coordinator
frames.desc: KV Coordinator sends directly to N1, N2 and N3. There is no N1 to N2 to N3 relay.

frames.title: W=2 waits for two durable acknowledgments
frames.desc: In this teaching scenario ACK means durable storage. N1 and N2 acknowledge to KV Coordinator; KV Coordinator returns success to Client. N3 can still lag.

frames.title: Read quorum intersects only on the same set
frames.desc: GET reuses the fan-out paths; replies from N2 and N3 satisfy R=2. Healthy write set N1,N2 and read set N2,N3 intersect at N2; concurrent versions still require reconciliation.

frames.title: Sloppy membership admits a disjoint read
frames.desc: Failure scenario replaces the healthy write: N2 is unreachable to the writer and the N3 write is delayed. N1 and fallback N4 acknowledge W=2. After N2 is reachable again, an R=2 read from old N2 and N3 can miss the write before delayed delivery or handoff.

frames.title: Hinted handoff eventually restores placement
frames.desc: Complete fan-out picture. N4 eventually sends the hinted copy directly to N2. Until handoff or delayed delivery completes, W={N1,N4} and R={N2,N3} are disjoint. KV Coordinator returns results to Client.

frames.title: Choose the range before the model
frames.desc: Client asks Range Reader for the most recent 50 messages in conversation 42.

frames.title: Route a short row-key range to a tablet
frames.desc: Range Reader sends the conversation/time-bucket key to Tablet, a contiguous row-key range.

frames.title: Qualifiers name distinct messages
frames.desc: Tablet scans Wide row conv#42#day. Its msg family maps ordered time/message-id qualifiers to bytes. Qualifiers are data fields inside the row, not network services.

frames.title: Cells return through every hop
frames.desc: Wide row returns cells to Tablet, then Range Reader, then Client. Fifty assumed 400-byte messages total 20 KB before protocol overhead.

frames.title: Bound row growth and expose hot buckets
frames.desc: Complete range path. The rejected red alternative Range Reader to Wide row warns against an unbounded hot row. Time buckets bound size but cannot spread writes to one current hot bucket.

frames.title: Create an upload session on the control path
frames.desc: Client sends init to Upload App. Only metadata and upload control pass through Upload App.

frames.title: Reserve durable pending metadata
frames.desc: Upload App reserves PENDING Metadata under a caller/key and returns a control result through Upload App to Client. This is an upload session, not a committed object.

frames.title: Bytes go directly to create-only Object store
frames.desc: The same Client is drawn again on the byte lane. Client sends signed PUT directly to Object store and Object store returns a receipt directly to Client. Upload App is outside this data path.

frames.title: Finalize verifies an exact object
frames.desc: Client finalizes through the existing control path. Upload App HEADs the exact object version and checks size/checksum. Object store returns proof to Upload App before publication.

frames.title: Publish with CAS and fence cleanup
frames.desc: Upload App conditionally changes Metadata from PENDING to COMMITTED using the existing control RPCs, then returns committed id. Expired PENDING may be CAS-claimed as ABORTED for cleanup; COMMITTED is never cleaned by that path.

frames.title: Save authority before deriving search
frames.desc: Client calls Writer, which commits document and outbox in one Source store transaction. Source store replies Writer, then Writer replies Client with saved id.

frames.title: A durable relay closes the publish gap
frames.desc: Source store outbox feeds Outbox Relay asynchronously. Writer does not publish from memory after commit.

frames.title: Indexer applies versions and deletion records
frames.desc: Outbox Relay delivers at least once to Indexer, which writes derived Inverted index and receives its acknowledgment. Search visibility may lag the source commit.

frames.title: Search retrieves candidates, not authority
frames.desc: Query Client calls Search App. Search App queries Inverted index through its left port; candidate ids and versions return from the index bottom to Search App.

frames.title: Hydrate and authorize from the source
frames.desc: Search App reads Source store, which returns current ACL, version and deletion state to Search App. Search App returns validated results to Query Client.

frames.title: Failure returns through Search App
frames.desc: Complete source/outbox/index/query path. The alternate red failure Inverted index to Search App to Query Client returns a bounded error if the index is unavailable; the index does not become authority.

frames.title: Read the B-tree page structure
frames.desc: One Engine API choice is shown. On the B-tree alternative Engine accesses B-tree pages; page results return to Engine, then Client. Pages represent buffer-managed logical pages, not a commit before WAL.

frames.title: WAL must precede persistent data-page flush
frames.desc: For B-tree writes dirty buffer pages produce durable B-tree WAL before data-page flush. WAL acknowledgment returns to the page operation, then Engine, then Client. This is the abstract ordering constraint.

frames.title: LSM first appends durable WAL
frames.desc: The lower path is an alternative LSM engine. Engine appends to LSM WAL and receives its durable acknowledgment. A full client write result still requires memory application.

frames.title: Apply the durable write to Memtable
frames.desc: After the required WAL barrier Engine inserts the version into Memtable, which replies to Engine. Engine may now return the write result to Client on its shared output path.

frames.title: Flush immutable files asynchronously
frames.desc: Memtable flushes immutable SSTables asynchronously and receives completion. The write acknowledgment need not wait for this flush when the required WAL is durable.

frames.title: Compaction trades read work for disk work
frames.desc: Complete alternative-engine diagram. SSTables are rewritten by asynchronous compaction. Reads reconcile memory and files; Bloom filters can skip absent point keys but cannot return row values. Compaction backlog may stall writes.

frames.title: An analytic query uses one declared snapshot
frames.desc: Analyst sends SUM(amount) to Query Root for one declared immutable snapshot. This is not checkout commit or one wide-row lookup.

frames.title: A leaf scans the selected column
frames.desc: Query Root asks Leaf A, which reads Amount stripe A. At 8 bytes per row the amount column is much narrower than 1,500-byte rows.

frames.title: Fan out over disjoint snapshot fragments
frames.desc: Query Root also asks Leaf B, which reads disjoint Amount stripe B from the same snapshot. Leaves process different fragments in parallel.

frames.title: Every value and partial sum returns through its caller
frames.desc: Amount stripe A returns values to Leaf A, then partial sum to Query Root. Amount stripe B returns values to Leaf B, then partial sum to Query Root. Query Root returns the sum to Analyst.

frames.title: A missing fragment cannot be called an exact sum
frames.desc: Complete aggregation tree. The failure alternate Amount stripe B to Leaf B to Query Root to Analyst refuses an exact sum with a missing fragment. Normal paths are muted only on that failed branch.

normalPath.mode: independent static walkthrough, not an executed network test
steps: Client sends one new HTTP/2 RPC over downstream TLS to L7. L7 terminates/parses it, filters a current endpoint snapshot by READY and health, samples two distinct available targets and selects the lower observedActive target. No available target yields503, without unhealthy panic fallback.

The request carries the selected incarnation and a remaining budget converted into the receiving App monotonic clock domain. Before the handler/expensive work, the selected App locks its Gate, samples now after acquiring the lock, checks exact incarnation, READY, now<deadline and active<limit, then registers an owner-bound permit.

The protected handler reads the current shared session authority; a valid sid/expiry/revocation version allows the declared business action. Persisted business effects/idempotency results remain external authority rather than process-only state.

App replies to L7, which maps it to the original downstream stream and returns to Client. Only actual handler/stream completion calls finish; the exact Gate/incarnation check and set removal release that permit once.

independentCounterexamples.name: Two stale ingress observations race for the last local permit
steps: LB A and LB B both observe the same READY App and stale observedActive=2. The authoritative App Gate actually has limit-1 active work.
Both may select it; the first serialized tryAdmit increments active to limit. The second observes full capacity under the same lock and returns null. Choice metrics did not reserve capacity.

If beginDrain won the lock first, both late routes fail READY; if the address was reused under a new incarnation, old expectedIncarnation is rejected. An operation blocked on the lock until its exact deadline is also denied because time is sampled after locking.
independentCounterexamples.result: No oversubscription is promised by P2C; the invariant is enforced by the App-local gate, assuming every ingress enters it.

independentCounterexamples.name: Caller cancellation does not prove SQL or a stream stopped
steps: An admitted handler holds one permit while executing a write or generating a stream. Caller timeout/cancel may end the ingress attempt while server work continues.
Do not call finish or clear active merely on cancellation. Saturated Gate continues rejecting new work until actual completion or confirmed physical termination.
Duplicate finish removes the permit once; a permit from another Gate/incarnation cannot release replacement capacity. A new Gate object in the same still-active process must not hide old work.
independentCounterexamples.result: The prose preserves the physical-completion integration precondition and does not claim the Java API can infer physical completion by itself.

independentCounterexamples.name: Planned drain versus sudden failure
steps: For a planned exit, beginDrain(inc11,revision50,budget30) closes the local READY gate atomically before withdrawal publication. A repeated identical drain keeps the original cutoff. Old routes are denied; already admitted work stays on this live instance.

Only a trusted coordinator ACK matching both inc11 and revision50 at the relevant ingress barrier counts. Wrong incarnation/revision, ordinary readiness=false or an asynchronous EndpointSlice update are insufficient. ACK plus actual active=0 permits CLEAN_EXIT.

At the cutoff with active>0 or missing ACK, pollDrain returns FORCE_REQUIRED without clearing work or proving OS exit. External cancellation/close/kill and supervisor observation remain necessary. GOAWAY cooperation is needed for new HTTP/2 streams on existing L4 flows.

A sudden crash has no guaranteed draining phase. Fixed-start probes can continue selecting it for the assumed4.5s window. Replacement uses a new WARMING incarnation; late old probes, routes, completion callbacks and drain commands cannot reopen or alter it.
independentCounterexamples.result: 30s is a bounded forced-shutdown decision, not a completion/rollback guarantee; 4.5s is conditional detection budget.

independentCounterexamples.name: Shared sessions do not automatically make revocation durable or immediate at writes
steps: A request may read a valid old session just before revocation commits. A later sensitive write cannot claim zero post-revocation execution merely because ingress checked the session earlier.
Revocation epoch and the sensitive write need one serializable boundary or a proven equivalent protocol; renewals also compete by version so an unconditional old SET cannot restore revoked rights.
Session lookup timeout is unavailable and fails closed, distinct from a missing/expired unauthenticated session. A8 forbids positive local authorization caching.

Async Redis promotion can lose an acknowledged revocation; WAIT alone is not a strong-consistency proof. Use authority satisfying durability or pause protected work. Cookie affinity and a JWT signature do not replace these requirements.
independentCounterexamples.result: The new Chinese preserves the original strong security condition and explicit external prerequisites.

independentCounterexamples.name: Lost201 after commit leaves a write UNKNOWN
steps: DB commits an order/effect and its idempotency result, then the socket closes before201. A replacement stateless App cannot infer nonexecution.
Query the same tenant/principal/operation/resource/canonical-argument-bound key; replay only while its durable dedupe guarantee still holds. Changed parameters under the same key conflict.

The one-retry cap remains inside the original deadline/budget and safe semantics; external payment effects require their own authoritative receipts. Socket closure neither rolls back committed writes nor retracts already output tokens.
independentCounterexamples.result: No automatic POST retry is inferred from statelessness or missing replies.

independentCounterexamples.name: Maglev and DSR do not migrate TCP state
steps: A healthy local ConnTrack binding to App1 takes precedence over a table lookup. Only missing/invalid bindings consult table[hash(flow) mod M]; tables are built off path and swapped whole.

When LB1 fails, LB2 has no local c1 binding. Identical ordered identities, health set, weights, M, hash seeds and algorithm version can deterministically pick the same healthy App1; it must still own the original TCP state.

If r8 remaps c1 to App2, App2 lacks that TCP state and sends RESET via Router here, or another implementation drops and times out. If App1 is dead, identical tables also cannot preserve the connection. Surviving owners can exchange slots, so affected slots are not guaranteed to equal only1/N.

In the declared GRE+DSR topology, App1 replies with the VIP through Router to Client, bypassing software LB. This needs encapsulation/VIP source/routing support and does not remove L7 response processing in the earlier topology. Uniform slots do not bound CPU/bytes or fix a1200RPC/s single flow against1000/s capacity.

  1. 先确定按什么粒度选择后端：一条连接、一次新 RPC，还是已经开始的长流？

A8 查当前会话且不作正向本地授权缓存：不存在/过期是未登录，查超时是不可用，不能放行。续期与撤销按版本原子竞争，不能无条件 SET 续回旧权限。Redis 默认异步复制，WAIT 也不把它变为强一致，切主仍可能丢已确认撤销；选满足耐久契约的权威，或故障时暂停受保护操作。[5]
fullOldNew.new:
如果保存 sid=s9 的本地表因 OOM 丢失，Cookie 也找不回这条会话。迁移时，要先持久化有效的 sid、主体、过期时间和撤销版本（epoch），再切换到新的权威来源读取。即使迁移期间同时读两处，也不能只因某个旧副本说“有效”就放行。无状态应用仍可以在内存中保留连接池、在途请求和可重建缓存；购物车、订单、聊天消息和幂等结果则需要由外部持久存储保存并确认。连接网关中的临时在线状态（presence），也需要说明断线后如何重连。

A8 要求每次读取当前会话，不在本地缓存“允许访问”的授权结果。会话不存在或已过期，表示未登录；查询超时则表示服务不可用，此时不能放行。续期和撤销要按版本原子竞争，不能用无条件 SET 把旧权限续回来。Redis 默认使用异步复制，WAIT 也不会把它变成强一致存储；切换主节点时，已确认的撤销仍可能丢失。因此要选择满足持久化要求的权威存储，或在故障期间暂停受保护操作。[5]

fullOldNew.old:

每受保护 API 一查时，A1 是约 6,000 次会话读/s。A7 单份 1,000,000×256=256 MB，两份 512 MB 只是裸记录，索引、TTL、复制缓冲和余量另算；小体积不证明单机吞吐。按源 IP 亲和还可能把同 NAT 的大量用户压到同一台。
fullOldNew.new:
入口完成鉴权后，权限仍可能被撤销，两者会与后续业务写入发生竞争。如果承诺“撤销提交后，不再发生敏感写入”，就要把撤销版本与业务写放进同一个可串行化边界，或证明另一个协议具有等价保证；单独查询共享会话还不够。JWT 签名不会加密内容，也不会自动实现即时撤销。Cookie 属性、登录或权限变化时的标识轮换，以及登出后的服务端失效处理，按 OWASP 的建议执行。[6]

如果每次受保护 API 都查询一次会话，按 A1 就约为每秒 6,000 次会话读取。A7 中，单份裸记录为 1,000,000×256=256 MB，两份共 512 MB；索引、TTL、复制缓冲和余量要另外计算。数据体积小，并不能证明单机吞吐足够。按源 IP 设置亲和还可能让同一个 NAT 后的大量用户集中到一台 App。

fullOldNew.new: A3 部署 12 台，停一台后仍有 6,600 次/秒的规划容量；再坏一台就只剩 6,000 次/秒，已经没有规划余量。多个实例共用机器时，要按整台机器损失的实例数重算。

fullOldNew.new: 按 A5，平均在途请求数为 6,000×0.05=300，这是 Little 定律给出的均值。本例不设请求等待队列，额度满了就拒绝；并发上限和尾延迟仍需实测，改变选择算法不会增加总容量。

fullOldNew.old: 候选先满足当前成员快照中的 READY、健康/未摘除与相应 incarnation。普通同构短请求可轮询；异构权重要来自同工作量与 SLO 下的容量。least-connection 数连接，HTTP/2 一条可能承载许多 RPC；等容量 P2C 随机取两个不同候选，选观测 active 更少者。Envoy 等权默认两候选，非等权有另一条动态加权分支；下面不复刻完整产品算法。[4]
fullOldNew.new: 选择后端前，要先按当前成员快照筛选：实例处于 READY，健康且未被摘除，并对应当前服务代次（incarnation）。对于工作量相近的同构短请求，可以采用轮询；异构后端的权重，则应依据同一工作负载和 SLO 下的容量。最少连接算法（least-connection）比较连接数，但一条 HTTP/2 连接可能携带很多 RPC。对于等容量后端，P2C 会随机抽取两个不同候选，再选择观测活跃请求数较少的一个。Envoy 在等权时默认比较两个候选，非等权时另有动态加权分支；下面的示例没有复刻完整产品算法。[4]

fullOldNew.old:
observedActive 是这个入口所见未结束的 upstream attempt，可能滞后；入口超时后服务端也可能仍在执行。本章显式无可用目标就返回 503，不是 Envoy 的默认 panic 回退政策。[13] READY 也不等于有剩余额度，多个 LB 同看 active=2 仍会同时拥向一台。

真正保证在途不超过 limit 的是所选 App 本地门。以下 Java 17 摘录对应图4 App admission：所有入口在 handler 开始前调用，锁内同时检查代次、READY、进程本地 deadline 和额度，再登记 permit；本例队列长度为 0。只在真实 handler/stream 结束时 finish；调用方超时或发 cancel 不提前释放。完整可运行代码与并发验证在 examples/ch39。
fullOldNew.new:
observedActive 记录当前入口所见、尚未结束的上游请求尝试，可能滞后于服务端实际情况。即使入口已超时，服务端也可能仍在执行。本章明确规定，没有可用目标就返回 503，这与 Envoy 默认的 panic 回退策略不同。[13] 实例处于 READY，也不表示它还有剩余额度：多个 LB 都可能看到 active=2，然后同时选中它。

真正把在途工作限制在 limit 以内的是所选 App 的本地准入机制。下面的 Java 17 摘录对应图4中的 App admission。所有入口路径都必须在请求处理函数（handler）开始前调用它：在同一把锁下检查代次、READY、进程本地的请求截止时间和剩余额度，然后登记许可（permit）。本例不设请求等待队列。只有服务端的请求处理函数或流真正结束时，才调用 finish；调用方超时或发出取消请求，都不能提前释放额度。完整可运行代码与并发验证见 examples/ch39。

fullOldNew.old: finish 绑定 Gate 和代次，并用集合删除保证只释放一次。本地锁只保护这一台 App；观测计数不是全局额度协议。deadline 用锁后采样的 monotonic 时钟，跨机器传剩余预算后再转换，不能直接比较两台的 nanoTime。
fullOldNew.new: finish 会核对许可所属的 Gate 和服务代次，并通过从集合中删除许可，保证每份额度只释放一次。本地锁只保护这一台 App，入口观测到的计数也不能充当全局额度分配协议。请求截止时间使用进程本地的单调时钟，必须在拿到锁后再读取当前时间。跨机器应传递剩余预算，并转换到接收进程的时钟域，不能直接比较两台机器的 nanoTime。

fullOldNew.old: 展开 A1–A5：正常、故障、重试与均值
fullOldNew.new: 展开 A1–A5：容量怎样随故障、重试和请求耗时变化

fullOldNew.old:
单 App 规划 1,000×60%=600/s；正常至少 6,000÷600=10 台，恰好覆盖。12 台各在独立机器，一台故障剩 11×600=6,600/s，峰值使用规划值的约 90.9%；发布停一台再坏一台只剩 10×600=6,000/s，无规划余量。若三机各四个实例，坏一机剩 8×600=4,800/s，缺 1,200/s，须增容或拒绝 20% 原始到达。

10% 原始请求各多一次等成本 attempt，执行率 6,000×1.1=6,600/s，吃完单故障预算；相关失败还会放大，需总重试预算、退避和 deadline。稳态 Little 定律给平均在途 6,000×0.050=300，不能用它设 limit=300 或证明 p99<200 ms。limit、等待队列与多维资源上限要按实测请求分布决定；本例不排队，饱和即拒绝。
fullOldNew.new:
单个 App 的规划容量为 1,000×60%=600 次/秒，因此正常情况下至少需要 6,000÷600=10 台，才能恰好覆盖峰值。部署在独立机器上的 12 台 App，失去一台后还剩 11×600=6,600 次/秒，峰值约占这份规划容量的 90.9%。如果发布时停一台，又故障一台，就只剩 10×600=6,000 次/秒，没有规划余量。如果改为三台机器、每台四个实例，坏一台机器就只剩 8×600=4,800 次/秒，缺口为 1,200 次/秒，必须增容或拒绝 20% 的原始到达请求。

如果 10% 的原始请求各增加一次等成本尝试，执行率就变为 6,000×1.1=6,600 次/秒，恰好吃完单台故障后的规划容量。相关失败还会进一步放大重试，因此要限制总重试预算，设置退避，并遵守截止时间。稳态下，Little 定律给出的平均在途请求数为 6,000×0.050=300；这个均值既不能用来直接设置 limit=300，也不能证明 p99<200 ms。并发上限、等待队列和各类资源上限，都要依据实测请求分布决定；本例没有等待队列，饱和时直接拒绝。

fullOldNew.old: 健康与排空：关本地门，再等旧工作
fullOldNew.new: 健康与排空：先拒绝新工作，再等待已有工作结束

fullOldNew.old: 健康检查有滞后，readiness 不是资源锁。计划下线在本地与准入原子竞争：先 DRAINING 拒新，再发布移除；已有工作保留。突然失败则停止新选择，不能承诺完成在途。
fullOldNew.new: 健康检查会滞后，就绪状态（readiness）也不能锁住资源。计划下线时，状态切换与本地准入必须原子竞争：先进入 DRAINING，拒绝新工作，再发布移除结果，同时保留已有工作。突然故障则要停止选择该实例，但不能保证它完成已经接下的请求。

fullOldNew.old: 先定义 READY 是能承接业务的证明，TCP 能连上只是其中一个条件；依赖失效时不应盲目继续进池。
fullOldNew.new: READY 应表示已有检查结果支持实例接收业务请求，TCP 能连上只是其中一个条件。依赖失效时，不能仅凭 TCP 可达就继续把它放入候选池。

fullOldNew.old: 计划下线先在本地关准入，再发布摘池；陈旧快照晚到的新请求也会被挡住。进程保持存活，入口移除确认是后续干净退出的条件。
fullOldNew.new: 计划下线时，先在本地关闭准入，再通知入口移除实例；即使旧快照把新请求送来，也会被本地拒绝。此时进程继续存活，后续还要确认入口已经移除它，才能干净退出。

fullOldNew.old: 已准入 RPC 仍绑定旧实例。L7 能停止新 stream；L4 只能停新流，旧 HTTP/2 连接还需服务端 GOAWAY 配合。
fullOldNew.new: 已经准入的 RPC 仍由旧实例处理。L7 可以停止分配新 stream；L4 只能停止选择新流，已有 HTTP/2 连接还需要服务端发送 GOAWAY 配合。

fullOldNew.old: 移除已确认且真实 active=0 才能干净退出。30 s 到点转强停流程，不把取消请求当完成；关闭 socket 也不会回滚已提交的写。
fullOldNew.new: 确认入口已移除实例，且服务端实际执行的工作数 active 归零后，才允许干净退出。30 s 到期时转入强停流程；发出取消请求不代表工作已经结束，关闭 socket 也不会回滚已提交的写入。

fullOldNew.old: 突然宕机走红线，不经过一个会自动完成请求的 drain 阶段。A9 的探测上界预算 4.5 s 内仍可能调到坏实例。
fullOldNew.new: 突然宕机沿红线进入故障分支，不会经历一个能保证请求完成的排空阶段。按 A9，在停止选择故障实例之前，仍可能有长达 4.5 s 的窗口把请求送向它。

fullOldNew.old: 恢复使用新 incarnation，先 WARMING 验版本、依赖与预热，再进 READY；旧成功探测不能把 DRAINING 或 UNHEALTHY 的旧门复活。
fullOldNew.new: 恢复时分配新的服务代次，先进入 WARMING，验证版本、依赖和预热结果后再进入 READY。迟到的成功探测不能把已处于 DRAINING 或 UNHEALTHY 的旧准入机制重新打开。

fullOldNew.old:
主动探测检查身份与代表性业务，被动信号观察真实超时/错误；TCP 可连只证明 listener 活着。[7] 共享依赖全失败时，盲目让所有实例同时退出会失去可恢复入口；检查分层、限频，区分共同依赖故障与单实例故障。短暂过载优先由额度拒绝和背压处理，别把每次 503 都当进程死掉再重启。

以下摘录闭合图5的计划分支。beginDrain 先核验命令的 incarnation 再关本地门，协调器随后发布带 revision 的移除。acknowledgeRemoval 只接受可信协调器对相关入口的确切代次/版本确认；普通 readiness=false 或 Kubernetes EndpointSlice 异步更新不等于这个屏障。[12] 若产品没有确认能力，按截止执行显式强停并承认晚路由风险，不能用 sleep 当证据。
fullOldNew.new:
主动探测要检查实例身份和有代表性的业务操作，被动信号则观察真实请求中的超时与错误；TCP 可达只能证明监听端口还在。[7] 如果所有实例共用的依赖故障，盲目把它们同时摘除，可能连恢复所需的入口也一并失去。应分层、限频地检查，并区分共同依赖故障与单实例故障。短暂过载优先通过准入拒绝和背压处理，不要把每次 503 都当作进程死亡而重启。

下面的摘录对应图5中的计划下线分支。beginDrain 先核对命令指定的服务代次，再关闭本地准入；协调器随后发布带成员版本号（revision）的移除结果。acknowledgeRemoval 只接受可信协调器的确认，确认必须覆盖相关入口，并精确对应这次服务代次与成员版本。单纯设置 readiness=false，或等待 Kubernetes EndpointSlice 异步更新，都不等于完成了这项确认。[12] 如果产品无法提供确认能力，就按截止时间进入明确的强停流程，并承认旧路由仍可能送来请求；等待一段固定时间不能充当移除证据。

fullOldNew.old:
重复 drain 保留原截止，不能续长；CLEAN_EXIT 要求移除确认且真实 active=0，FORCE_REQUIRED 只请求取消/关闭或强杀，不清计数，也不证明 OS 已退出。STOPPED 由外部 supervisor 确认。进程一代只允许 WARMING→READY 一次；DRAINING/UNHEALTHY 不被迟到探测复活，恢复在新进程 incarnation 完成预热，旧路由/回调不能改新门；不能在同进程另建 Gate 抹掉仍执行的旧工作。

walkthroughs.trace: A single-item DRAFT order at expected version 0 and stock 1 enters BEGIN IMMEDIATE; no saved result, order CAS produces SUBMITTED v1, stock condition decrements to 0, stable outbox event and saved response insert, then one COMMIT. If the response is lost, the same tenant/caller/key and original canonical request return the stored response without new stock/outbox effects. Changed order/version under that key rejects; lookup unavailable leaves UNKNOWN. Async loss of both business and result records cannot prove an external effect never happened.

walkthroughs.topic: Read token, history and pinned fresh snapshot
walkthroughs.trace: Token orders/T/1042 is satisfied only by a newly opened pinned view in orders/T with continuous visiblePrefix≥1042. A 1041 view waits within at most 20 ms and the API deadline. At timeout, an admitted eligible Primary may serve; old RR snapshots, another cluster, U:9999 forks and an ineligible new Primary cannot satisfy it. Pool reassignment or connection loss requires checking again.

Probe failure produces SUSPECT and paused routes. Actual storage exclusion/power fencing must establish FENCED before promotion. Recover the selected ACK prefix, replay and promote an eligible candidate, then publish higher route epoch and open. DNS/router epoch alone cannot stop an old connection committing. A still-durable 2-second apply lag replays rather than losing 2,000 writes. Loss of Primary and acknowledged A exceeds this fixed-A fault contract.

walkthroughs.topic: Migration S/H and guard atomic domain
walkthroughs.trace: Source owns rev7 while a consistent snapshot S copies and retained post-S changes/deletes replay. Versions/tombstones prevent stale snapshot resurrection. Every writer keeps the ownership shared lock through business/idempotency COMMIT; freeze exclusively takes the same row, waits for old and prepared work, durably records FROZEN and final H. A writer either commits before H or rejects after freeze. Target proof binds range/moveId/history/copy/deletes and continuous appliedPrefix≥H; durable directory CAS then exact grant activation gives rev8. Lost publication ACK queries the directory without reviving rev7; reverse migration needs reverse catch-up and Target fencing.

Order CAS=0 means rollback/state conflict; stock update=0 rolls back prior SUBMITTED; outbox/result insertion failure rolls back all. Only successful results persist, so known SOLD_OUT can succeed after replenishment. Known aborted transient failures may retry all decision reads and writes under bounded backoff/deadline for at most 3 total pseudocode attempts; COMMIT connection loss resolves the same key or remains UNKNOWN. SQLite single-writer serialization is a local adapter property, not distributed durability or PostgreSQL retry evidence.

Each DB persists PREPARED and holds locks before YES; all YES precede a durable coordinator COMMIT decision and phase-two messages. If one participant commits and another cannot obtain the decision, user timeout cannot justify unilateral abort. Recover/query original transaction_id and replay the same decision. Prepared/decision recovery does not supply global serial isolation or include PSP/email/shipping.

Correct normal route is row+outbox COMMIT → broker durable ACK → durable relay cursor; lost publish ACK/checkpoint causes stable e17 replay. Consumer commits unique inbox ID+digest+saved result and business effect in one Effect DB transaction, then ACKs MQ. Duplicate identical e17 is resolved from the committed inbox/result; mismatched payload conflicts and arbitrary constraint failures must not be ACKed. Early separate inbox COMMIT can lose an effect; late separate inbox after effect COMMIT can duplicate it. The final SVG footer violates this last boundary (CH41-R2). External email/PSP remains outside the DB transaction, and dedup retention must cover manual replay.

Run intent/state/version persists before each dispatch; remote stable keys protect effects and local receipt+run advancement commit together. Holds do not auto-expire in this exercise. Lost capture or shipping response queries the original operation and keeps UNKNOWN when lookup fails; do not recapture/refund by assumption. Refund/release requires authoritative terminal non-shipment/CANCELLED that rejects delayed shipping release. Inventory arbitrates HELD→consumed versus HELD→released; already consumed stock is not released. Stable refund key, durable compensation intents/results, bounded recovery and owned escalation handle failed/unknown compensation. Shipment winning the race requires after-sales handling; Saga exposes intermediate state and supplies no global isolation.
